label: No placebo
rationale: This is described as a multicenter, open-label, single-arm study in which each participant receives SNUG01. The record gives no placebo or sham comparator; instead, all arms are dose levels of the same investigational drug.

evidence.quote: Each Participant will receive a single dose

title: An IIT Clinical Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, and Preliminary Efficacy of a Single Intrathecal Injection of SNUG01 in Patients with Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
